name: JoAi: List Ledger Accounts

description.en: List the team chart of accounts, including bank, cash, revenue, VAT and private accounts.
description.de: Kontenplan des Teams anzeigen, inklusive Bank, Kasse, Erlöse, Umsatzsteuer und Privatkonten.
description.fr: Liste le plan comptable de l’équipe, avec banque, caisse, revenus, TVA et comptes privés.
description.es: Lista el plan de cuentas del equipo, incluidas banco, caja, ingresos, IVA y cuentas privadas.
description.it: Elenca il piano dei conti del team, inclusi banca, cassa, ricavi, IVA e conti privati.
description.ro: Listează planul de conturi al echipei, inclusiv bancă, casă, venituri, TVA și conturi private.

bot: Use when the user wants to see the bookkeeping accounts or find an account code/hash ID before booking.

inputs.name: Include archived
inputs.bot: Set true to include archived accounts.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.
description.fr: Slug de l’équipe pour cette action. Par défaut, l’équipe actuelle.
description.es: Slug del equipo para esta acción. Por defecto, el equipo actual.
description.it: Slug del team per questa azione. Predefinito: team attuale.
description.ro: Slug-ul echipei pentru această acțiune. Implicit echipa curentă.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
